mintAuthority.summary: PGOLD is minted by Pleasing International (Hong Kong) via EOA-controlled token contracts. On Ethereum, the CCIPAdmin EOA (0x142a96da) grants mint roles to the CCIP burn/mint pool (0xf3067615). On Arbitrum, the proxy owner EOA (0x142a96da) can call mint() directly; a separate proxy-admin contract (0x50ead2d2) is owned by a different EOA (0x7e5cc9bb). On ApeChain the token is non-upgradeable, owned by EOA 0x25a6a7fb.

controls.label: Pleasing issuer EOA — Ethereum CCIPAdmin / token owner
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295079, owner() on 0xfb0bd86210d2a10543bb40289e92d108b3a5334f returned 0x142a96da210dec495a76e56058563549ac12bab4; eth_getCode on that address returned 0x (EOA). getCCIPAdmin() returned the same address. getMinters() returned one address (0xf3067615 CCIP pool contract). The EOA can call grantMintRole/revokeMintRole to control the mint surface.

controls.label: CCIP burn/mint pool — active minter on Ethereum
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295079, getMinters() on the PGOLD ETH token returned [0xf3067615579d59c64f16f1382b6a8032622f810a]; eth_getCode confirms it is a contract (34 KB, Chainlink CCIP burn/mint pool). Minting through this pool requires a corresponding cross-chain message.

controls.label: Pleasing issuer EOA — Arbitrum token owner (direct mint)
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 472413865, owner() on proxy 0x3e76bb02286bfeaa89dd35f11253f2cbce634f91 returned 0x142a96da210dec495a76e56058563549ac12bab4; eth_getCode returns 0x (EOA). The implementation at 0xd81ea1e2179c983a45aa95929f189c2bd59788d7 exposes a plain mint(address,uint256) gated only by Ownable, so the owner EOA can mint directly.

controls.label: Proxy-admin upgrade authority — Arbitrum
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 472413865, EIP-1967 proxy-admin slot on 0x3e76bb returned 0x50ead2d211d84d111c692b86e02a489d3aa2e9ce (a ProxyAdmin contract, 3368 bytes). owner() on the ProxyAdmin returned 0x7e5cc9bb562eae2356fae7c59ea04c4677f73986; eth_getCode returns 0x (EOA). A different EOA from the token owner.

controls.label: Pleasing issuer EOA — ApeChain token owner (direct mint)
controls.evidence: On ApeChain, owner() on 0x64ae250e044688ddd04262f17daca23c28d241c2 returned 0x25a6a7fbe039c14b06adb6bda434b960981dbaed; eth_getCode confirms EOA. Contract is not a proxy (EIP-1967 slots are zero). Different issuer EOA from ETH/ARB.

review.evidence: Ethereum block 25295079: owner() = CCIPAdmin = 0x142a96da (EOA); getMinters() = [0xf3067615 CCIP pool, contract]. Arbitrum block 472413865: proxy owner = 0x142a96da (EOA), impl mint() gated only by Ownable; proxy-admin 0x50ead2d2 owned by EOA 0x7e5cc9bb. ApeChain: non-proxy, owner = 0x25a6a7fb (EOA). All on-chain mint surfaces resolved. Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): No named independent attestor, recurring cadence, or dated reserve-to-liability report was located; Pleasing Gold provides only issuer-controlled, ad hoc backing claims. No exact prudential stablecoin-issuer authorization for the issuer was found in Hong Kong SFC's public register. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer EOAs retain uncapped direct and role-admin mint paths; VISTO CPA independently reported on only Arbitrum liabilities and partly observed bullion, leaving other chain supply outside reconciliation, with no named prudential supervisor. Wave 2 external verification 2026-08-15: Pleasing's reserve and audit pages still expose only the partial June 2026 VISTO report, while the market site's daily-audit claim does not publish whole-supply independent evidence. Wave 1 reconciliation research 2026-08-15: Pleasing's official Reserve Report links a dated 25 June 2026 assurance PDF, but VISTO CPA's work covers only Arbitrum PGOLD liabilities and partial bullion observations, not the token's Ethereum and ApeChain outstanding supply; no recurring whole-supply reconciliation cadence is published, so reconciliation remains unknown.
